The Right to Hope for Jury Nullification

Yeah you aren't even allowed to discuss jury nullification as a juror, and attorneys are not allowed to present it as a viable option. Judges strike it down and order it struck from the record and order the jurors to disregard any statements and then have the bailiff instruct you to tell on any juror who discusses it so they can be removed.

It happened on a 2nd degree murder trial jury I sat on. So the foreman and I ignored them and discussed it and explained why it was not a viable option in our case, but that it would be a viable option for something like a drug case. The jurors got an education and we still found the guy guilty of murder and attempted murder. And nobody snitched.
I wish the right to jury nullification was taken seriously. When jurors can judge the law as well as the defendant, there is a chance that the effects of tyrannical legislation will be blunted.

Jury nullification is the only effective tool individual citizens have to limit the abuse of government power. Voting from the ballot box has little effect because they're overruled by the statist mob, and voting from the rooftops is frowned upon for a number of reasons (violating the NAP for starters).

However jury nullification provides an actually effective check on power in a peaceful and effective manner.
